name: Amongst the Ruins
summary: Tasked by Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Horde adventurers delve into the flooded temple of Blackfathom Deeps to recover a fathom core. The Earthen Ring seeks this relic to uncover the dark elemental plots of the invading Twilight's Hammer cult.

sections.title: A Threat in the Deep
sections.body: The ancient night elven temple of Blackfathom Deeps, once sacred to Elune, has fallen under the dominion of sinister forces. Deep within its submerged passages, the cultists of the Twilight's Hammer have established a stronghold. Stationed at the windswept shore of Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale, the Darkspear shaman Je'neu Sancrea observes the growing taint with rising alarm, recognizing that the cult intends to subjugate the local elements against the land and its defenders.

sections.title: The Fathom Stone
sections.body: To counter the cult's designs, Je'neu tasks Horde champions with securing a fathom core from the underwater fathom stone within the Moonshrine Ruins. When correctly deciphered by skilled shamans, the core reveals an exhaustive chronicle of elemental currents and disturbances. With this artifact in hand, the Earthen Ring hopes to pierce the veil of the Twilight's Hammer's operations and shield the region from elemental catastrophe.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Amongst the Ruins?
faq.answer: The quest is provided by Je'neu Sancrea, a troll representative of the Earthen Ring stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the Zoram Strand in western Ashenvale.

A fathom core is a specialized artifact housed within a submerged fathom stone in the ruins. When read by shamans, it provides a comprehensive history of elemental activity, revealing how the local elements are being coerced and manipulated.

faq.q: Why is the Earthen Ring concerned about Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: why does the earthen ring care
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring seeks balance between the natural elements. The Twilight's Hammer cultists who have overtaken the submerged ruins are actively corrupting and coercing the elements to serve their dark ends, threatening the stability of the entire region.

faq.q: Where is the fathom stone located?
faq.answer: The fathom stone rests submerged in the waters of the Moonshrine Ruins inside Blackfathom Deeps, requiring explorers to dive beneath the surface to retrieve the core.

faq.q: Can Alliance players take this quest?
aliases: can alliance do amongst the ruins
faq.answer: No. The quest is exclusive to the Horde, as Je'neu Sancrea operates out of the Horde outpost of Zoram'gar and aids the Horde's strategic presence in Ashenvale alongside his Earthen Ring duties.

faq.q: What group is occupying Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The cavernous temple complex has been seized by the Twilight's Hammer, an apocalyptic cult dedicated to serving sinister Old God entities and twisting the elements toward catastrophic ends.

angles.text: Retrieving the fathom core directly serves the Earthen Ring's mission to protect the spirits of water and earth from being coerced by the Twilight's Hammer.
By clearing out threats within Blackfathom Deeps, you safeguard Zoram'gar Outpost and secure the Horde's contested foothold on the Ashenvale coast.
Aiding Je'neu Sancrea helps a fellow Darkspear who bridges the divide between the Horde and the elemental caretakers of the Earthen Ring.
